whatThisIs: How this team packages, measured across every shipped package: what each phase does, how often, on what, with a real example. Evidence of practice, not rules - the order and the machine decide for any one package.
aboutPreviousVersionRemoval: generic = removed by name/folder/service whatever the version; version-pinned = a block naming one version or product code; none = nothing in pre-install (an MSI major upgrade or the vendor installer does it); other = something else in pre-install

commonTargets: $envCommonStartMenuPrograms\dSPACE Python Extensions 2024-A\dSPACE End User License Agreement.lnk  (x7)

howUpdatersWereSwitchedOff: 4x  New-ItemProperty -Path "$($RegPath)\$($SubKey1)" -Name "AutoUpdate" -Value "NO" -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null   e.g. Lenovo_Dock Manager and Firmware_x64_1.6.5.3-0001_MUL
3x  Remove-ADTFile -Path "$envCommonStartMenuPrograms\Vector Application Updater\Vector Application Updater.lnk"   e.g. Vector_DaVinciExternalComponents_x64_3.7.0-0001_MUL

3x  Start-ADTProcess -FilePath "$envWinDir\System32\schtasks.exe" -ArgumentList "/delete /tn `"LexCom\MANTIS Update Manager`" /f" -WindowStyle 'Hidden' -ErrorAction Continue   e.g. LexCom_MANTIS_x86_7.1.3.2.844-0001_MUL
2x  New-ItemProperty -Path "$($RegPath)\$($SubKey1)" -Name "AskBeforeFirmwareUpdate" -Value "NO" -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null   e.g. Lenovo_Dock Manager and Firmware_x64_1.6.5.3-0001_MUL
howShortcutsWereHandled: 8x  Remove-ADTFile -Path "$envCommonStartMenuPrograms\ZEISS PiWeb Enterprise\PiWeb MAN Start Help.lnk"
howRebootsWereHandled: 30x  Write-ADTLogEntry -Message "The package will be terminated with a Soft Reboot (3010), so that the detection script start...
